# Superposition Haskell OpenFeature Example and Benchmark setup

This is an example of using the Superposition openfeature provider in a haskell project. It also includes a benchmark setup to compare the performance of the Haskell implementation with the baseline Rust implementation.

To run benchmarks, you can use the following command:

```bash
cabal run benchmark:resolve
```

Benchmarks (Apple M2 Pro, 16GB memory):

| Contexts |  Haskell time |  Rust time|
|  -- |            -- |         -- |
| 1k     |    47.3 us      |   46.0 us|
| 10k    |    335.7 us     |  354.9 us|
| 50k    |    3.28 ms      |  3.59 ms|
| 100k   |    7.97 ms      |  8.24 ms|
| 200k   |    17.70 ms     |  28.7 ms|
| 500k   |    44.80 ms     |  45.5 ms|
| 1M     |    93.23 ms     |  95.5 ms|
